title: Planters, labor groups renew call for higher millgate sugar prices

blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY – Sugarcane growers and labor unions in Negros Occidental renewed their call for fairer farmgate sugar prices on Saturday, pointing out that recent price increases remain insufficient to cover high production costs and sustain small-scale planters. Recent raw sugar bidding results showed gains across major mills in the province, with Hawaiian-Philippine Co. reaching P2,888 per 50-kilogram bag (Lkg), First Farmers Holding Corp. rising to P2,760/Lkg, and Universal Robina Corp. (URC) mills alongside Victorias Milling Co. (VMC) posting upticks to P2,660/Lkg. Molasses prices also improved, offering slight relief to distressed farmers.
